style: STYLE: 2D hand-painted digital illustration, painterly semi-realism with visible soft brushwork and gentle texture, like a premium illustrated story game. NOT 3D, not a 3D render, not a photo, not anime, not flat vector, not cartoon. Soft painted edges, no thick black outlines. Warm soft Mediterranean sunlight from the upper left, gentle shadows. Palette: sand #E8D3A9, cream #F5EBD7, terracotta #C0643B, olive #7A7A3A, cedar brown #5A3E2B, sea blue #2F7F9E, indigo #2E3A6B, gold #D9A441. Avoid neon, pure black, and cold gray-blue.
scene: The place: the fishing docks in Joppa's harbor around AD 40. One weathered wooden dock on stone footings, with rocky shore, clear blue water, small wooden fishing boats, and a stone watchtower on the rocks in the distance. This picture is one close view of that dock.
after_rules: RULES: Tallest portrait format (9:16), full scene edge to edge. No text, no letters, no signs, no watermark. No people, no animals in the foreground. Camera at a standing adult's eye height. First-century Mediterranean only: wood, rope, stone, clay, iron; nothing modern (no glass lanterns, no metal cleats, no plastic). This is the RESTORED state: bright warm daylight, sturdy repaired wood, neatly coiled ropes, baskets of fish, a busy welcoming feel.
before_rules: Edit the attached picture into its NEGLECTED state from before it was repaired. Keep exactly the same camera angle, framing, layout and background so the two pictures line up perfectly; change only the condition of things. Rotten and broken wood, frayed ropes, seaweed and debris, empty baskets, muted faded colours, gray hazy light. Neglected, not scary. No text, no people, no animals.
